list.name: symbole
list.label: Instrument
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT im.symbole FROM instrument_marche im JOIN serie_prix sp ON sp.instrument_id = im.instrument_id ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT im.symbole FROM instrument_marche im JOIN serie_prix sp ON sp.instrument_id = im.instrument_id ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - max(sp.date_heure)))/60 AS "minutes depuis la derniere bougie" FROM serie_prix sp JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = sp.plateforme_id WHERE p.nom = 'Binance'

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - max(sp.date_heure)))/60 AS "minutes depuis la derniere bougie" FROM serie_prix sp JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = sp.plateforme_id WHERE p.nom = 'Coinbase'

SELECT 'serie_prix' AS "table", count(*) AS "lignes", max(date_heure) AS "derniere donnee" FROM serie_prix UNION ALL SELECT 'indicateur_technique', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM indicateur_technique UNION ALL SELECT 'prediction_modele', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM prediction_modele UNION ALL SELECT 'activite_marche', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM activite_marche UNION ALL SELECT 'sentiment_social', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM sentiment_social UNION ALL SELECT 'evenement_marche', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM evenement_marche UNION ALL SELECT 'signal_trading', count(*), max(date_heure) FROM signal_trading
SELECT count(*) AS "bougies sur 24 h" FROM serie_prix WHERE date_heure > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Prix de fermeture $symbole par plateforme (5 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sp.date_heure,$__interval), p.nom AS metric, avg(sp.prix_fermeture) AS value FROM serie_prix sp JOIN instrument_marche im ON im.instrument_id = sp.instrument_id JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = sp.plateforme_id WHERE im.symbole = '$symbole' AND sp.pas_temps = '5m' AND $__timeFilter(sp.date_heure) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Volume $symbole par heure et par plateforme

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sp.date_heure,'1h'), p.nom AS metric, sum(sp.volume) AS value FROM serie_prix sp JOIN instrument_marche im ON im.instrument_id = sp.instrument_id JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = sp.plateforme_id WHERE im.symbole = '$symbole' AND sp.pas_temps = '5m' AND $__timeFilter(sp.date_heure) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bougies 5 min recues par heure (12 attendues par serie)
panels.description: 12 bougies par heure et par serie = collecte complete. Une chute revele un trou de collecte.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sp.date_heure,'1h'), p.nom || ' ' || im.symbole AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM serie_prix sp JOIN instrument_marche im ON im.instrument_id = sp.instrument_id JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = sp.plateforme_id WHERE sp.pas_temps = '5m' AND $__timeFilter(sp.date_heure) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(it.date_heure,$__interval), p.nom AS metric, avg(it.rsi_14) AS value FROM indicateur_technique it JOIN instrument_marche im ON im.instrument_id = it.instrument_id JOIN plateforme p ON p.plateforme_id = it.plateforme_id WHERE im.symbole = '$symbole' AND it.pas_temps = '5m' AND $__timeFilter(it.date_heure) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
